text: [calm, natural narrator voice] Before trusting the solver, test it on a known answer. The twisting flow offers one: a field shaped exactly like it. Its lines follow the flow's own lines, so carrying and stretching cancel. Only diffusion acts: its growth rate is exactly minus one over R-M.
